# DreamHost

> DreamHost is an independent, employee-owned web hosting provider founded in 1997, hosting over 1.5 million websites. We provide the Remixer agentic AI website and app builder, shared web hosting, WordPress hosting, VPS hosting, managed VPS hosting, dedicated servers, domain registration, professional email, and professional web services — with a 100% uptime guarantee and 24/7 in-house support.

## Company Overview

DreamHost has been providing web hosting services since 1997 and hosts over 1.5 million websites globally. We are employee-owned — no private equity, no corporate parent — so decisions prioritize customer success over investor returns. We're committed to renewable energy, strong privacy protection, and open source contributions. New customers can receive a free custom website with any web hosting plan.

## Remixer Agentic AI Website & App Builder

Remixer is DreamHost's agentic AI website and app builder: describe what you need in plain language and Remixer plans and builds it — full websites and web apps with logins, payments, and a database built in, no code required. Start from a description, a template, or both.

- [Remixer Agentic AI Website & App Builder](https://www.dreamhost.com/remixer-website-builder/) - Product overview, pricing, and free trial
- Standalone subscription: $9.99/month billed yearly ($14.99 month-to-month)
- Hosting and global CDN included — no separate hosting plan needed
- 1,000 AI credits per month, plus 1,000 bonus credits in the first month
- 30-day free trial, no credit card required

## WordPress Hosting

- [WordPress Hosting Overview](https://www.dreamhost.com/wordpress/) - Optimized hosting starting at $1.99/month
- [Managed WordPress (DreamPress)](https://www.dreamhost.com/wordpress/managed/) - High-performance managed WordPress with staging, caching, and more
- [WordPress Migration Services](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/free-wordpress-migrations/) - Free automated and professional migration
- [WordPress Install Assistant](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/wordpress-install-assistant/) - Guided WordPress setup
- [WordPress Staging](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/wordpress-staging/) - Test changes before going live with one-click deployment
- [WordPress Backups](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/wordpress-backups/) - Automated backup solutions (backups not guaranteed)
- [WordPress Caching](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/wordpress-caching/) - Built-in performance optimization

## Hosting Services

- [Hosting Overview](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/) - All hosting solutions
- [Web Hosting](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/web-hosting/) - Shared hosting plans from $1.99/month
- [VPS Hosting](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/) - Virtual private servers with full root access, unmetered bandwidth with $0 overage charges, from $5.99/month
- [Managed VPS Hosting](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/managed-vps/) - Fully managed virtual private servers with unmetered bandwidth and $0 overage charges, from $10/month (Nginx web server, no root access)
- [Dedicated Servers](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/dedicated/) - High-performance dedicated hosting with 100% uptime guarantee (Nginx web server)
- [Online Store Hosting](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/online-store/) - WooCommerce e-commerce hosting
- [Hosting Reviews](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/reviews/) - Customer testimonials and ratings
- [Pricing](https://www.dreamhost.com/pricing/) - All plans and pricing
- [Switch to DreamHost](https://www.dreamhost.com/switch-to-dreamhost/) - Migrate from another host

## VPS One-Click Apps

VPS hosting includes full root/sudo access and one-click deployment for popular open-source applications:

- [n8n](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/n8n/) - Self-hosted workflow automation with 1,900+ integrations
- [Docker + Portainer](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/docker/) - Docker Engine, Compose, and Portainer CE for container management
- [Supabase](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/supabase/) - Open-source Firebase alternative: Postgres database, auth, storage, realtime APIs
- [PostgreSQL](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/postgresql/) - Dedicated PostgreSQL database server
- [Node.js](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/nodejs/) - Node.js 24 LTS with fnm (Fast Node Manager), PM2, Nginx reverse proxy, and Certbot SSL
- [GitLab CE](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/gitlab/) - Self-hosted Git, CI/CD pipelines, and container registry
- [Ghost](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/ghost/) - Publishing platform for blogs, newsletters, and memberships
- [Nextcloud](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/nextcloud/) - Private file storage, calendars, and collaboration suite
- [Dokploy](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/dokploy/) - Self-hosted PaaS for deploying apps with Git-based deploys and automatic SSL
- [OpenClaw](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/openclaw/) - Open-source AI assistant for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack
- [Hermes Agent](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/hermes-agent/) - Open-source AI agent by Nous Research with persistent memory, self-improving skills, and a web UI
- [Umami](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/umami/) - Open-source (MIT) web analytics with goals, funnels, journeys, session replay, and heatmaps; pre-installed with PostgreSQL and a Caddy reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS on Debian 13
- [LAMP Stack](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/lamp/) - Linux + Apache + MariaDB + PHP with phpMyAdmin
- [Ubuntu](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/ubuntu/) - Base OS image (26.04 LTS or 24.04 LTS)
- [Debian 13](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/debian/) - Base OS image
- [AlmaLinux](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/alma-linux/) - RHEL-compatible base OS image (AlmaLinux 10 or 9, required for cPanel)
- [Rocky Linux](https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/rocky-linux/) - Community-governed, RHEL-compatible base OS image (Rocky Linux 10 or 9)

## Email Services

- [Business Email Hosting](https://www.dreamhost.com/products/email/) - Professional email at your own domain with 25GB storage per mailbox (free-trial mailboxes start at 1GB)
- [Google Workspace](https://www.dreamhost.com/products/email/google-workspace/) - Gmail for business with Google's productivity suite

- Sending limits: 100 recipients per hour, 25 emails per 15 minutes
- 40MB maximum message size
- Advanced spam filtering with MailChannels
- DKIM signing and SPF records included

## Features & Tools

- [Traffic Dashboard](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/traffic-dashboard/) - Analytics and insights

## Professional Services

- [Pro Services Overview](https://www.dreamhost.com/pro-services/) - Expert design, development, management, and marketing services
- [Custom Web Design](https://www.dreamhost.com/pro-services/design/custom-web-design/) - Professionally designed websites
- [Web Development](https://www.dreamhost.com/pro-services/development/) - Custom development projects

- [Hacked Site Repair](https://www.dreamhost.com/pro-services/management/hacked-site-repair/) - Malware removal and site recovery

- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.dreamhost.com/pro-services/marketing/social-media-marketing/) - Social media management

## Security & Performance

- [Security Features](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/security/) - Comprehensive security suite including Web Application Firewall
- [DreamShield](https://www.dreamhost.com/products/dreamshield/) - Malware scanning and site protection add-on
- [SSL/TLS Certificates](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/ssl-tls-certificates/) - Free Let's Encrypt SSL
- [CDN Services](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/cdn/) - Bunny CDN integration
- [Domain Privacy](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/private-registration/) - Free WHOIS protection
- [Two-Factor Authentication](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/security/) - Google Authenticator and YubiKey support
- **Note: Not HIPAA compliant, no Business Associate Agreements available**

## Supported Technologies

### Container & Orchestration
- **Docker**: One-click install on VPS (Docker Engine + Compose + Portainer CE). Also installable on Dedicated Servers with admin user. Not available on Shared or Managed VPS hosting
- **Kubernetes**: Installable on VPS or Dedicated Servers with admin user (root access required)

### Databases
- **MySQL 8**: Fully supported on all managed hosting plans; MariaDB included in the VPS LAMP image
- **PostgreSQL**: One-click install on VPS (standalone or via Supabase). Not supported on Shared or Managed VPS hosting
- **MongoDB/NoSQL**: Installable on VPS or Dedicated Servers (root access required). Not supported on Shared or Managed VPS hosting
- **SQLite3**: Supported on all servers
- **Redis**: Available on DreamPress Pro plans; installable on VPS and Dedicated Servers
- **Backup retention**: 5-day retention for databases (vs 2-week for files) on managed hosting

### Runtime Environments
- **PHP**: 8.x current standard, [PHP 7.x Extended Support](https://www.dreamhost.com/products/php-extended-support/) available
- **Python**: 3.x supported (virtual environment required on managed hosting); any version installable on VPS
- **Ruby**: Full support with Ruby on Rails (VPS/Dedicated servers required)
- **Node.js**: One-click Node.js 24 LTS image on VPS; supported on Managed VPS and Dedicated Servers (not Shared hosting)
- **Java JRE**: Supported on all servers
- **Go/Erlang/Elixir/other runtimes**: Installable on VPS or Dedicated Servers with admin user (root access)

### Development Tools
- **Git**: Installed on all servers
- **cURL**: Installed on all servers
- **Composer/npm/yarn**: Supported for local installation
- **WebSockets**: Full support on VPS; Managed VPS/Dedicated use non-privileged ports (no public proxy server support)
- **Apache mods** (shared hosting): mod_rewrite (YES), mod_security (YES), mod_perl (NO), mod_proxy (VPS/Dedicated only)

### Platform Capabilities by Hosting Type
- **Shared Hosting**: No root/sudo, no Docker, no Node.js, no PostgreSQL, memory-intensive apps restricted
- **Managed VPS**: No root/sudo, persistent processes allowed, Node.js supported, custom Apache/Nginx config
- **VPS**: Full root/sudo access, any Linux software installable, choice of Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, or AlmaLinux 9
- **Dedicated with Admin**: Full root/sudo access, Docker/Kubernetes installable, all databases supported
- **WordPress Multisite**: Subdomain setup requires VPS/Dedicated (wildcard DNS needed), subdirectory setup works on Shared

### Not Supported
- **.NET/ASP**: No Microsoft technologies on Linux servers
- **FTPS**: Not supported (use SFTP instead)
- **Passenger**: Not supported on DreamHost servers
- **cPanel/Plesk on managed hosting**: DreamHost managed hosting uses a custom control panel; cPanel can be self-installed on VPS (AlmaLinux image)

## Technical Specifications

### Infrastructure
- **Operating System**: Ubuntu LTS on managed hosting; Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, or AlmaLinux 9 on VPS
- **Data Centers**: Ashburn, Virginia; Hillsboro, Oregon; Amsterdam, Netherlands; Singapore
- **Web Servers**: Apache (shared hosting/DreamPress), Nginx (Managed VPS/Dedicated), your choice on VPS
- **Bandwidth**: Unmetered on VPS with $0 overage charges
- **Email**: 1GB default storage expandable to 25GB, sending limits apply (100 recipients/hour)

Why DreamHost

Built Differently — On Purpose

We believe hosting should be open, reliable, and human. That belief shapes everything from our infrastructure to our support experience — here's how we deliver.

Every Millisecond Matters

NVMe storage. Global CDN across 100+ locations. A modern stack built by engineers who’ve spent nearly three decades obsessing over performance. Speed is built into every layer of the architecture.

  • NVMe SSD storage on every plan, up to 10x faster load times than SATA
  • CDN delivers your content from 100+ locations worldwide
  • Pages start loading the instant a visitor clicks
  • Faster sites rank higher on Google. Period.

AI Built In, Not Bolted On

Build your website, analyze your traffic logs, and get business advice — all powered by AI tools built directly into the platform.

  • Remixer builds your full site from a conversation
  • AI log summaries surface issues and guide troubleshooting
  • Business Advisor delivers data-backed growth recommendations
  • Try Remixer free for 30 days, no credit card required

Built for a Global Audience

Launch near your customers, then let our global CDN take it from there. With data centers across 3 continents and 100+ edge locations worldwide, your content stays quick no matter where people click from.

  • US-East (Ashburn, VA)
  • US-West (Hillsboro, OR)
  • Amsterdam, Netherlands (EU)
  • Singapore (Asia-Pacific)
  • 100+ CDN edge locations fill in the gaps worldwide

Full Visibility Into Your Stack

See what’s happening across your stack — without rummaging through tools. From server usage to traffic insights, everything lives in one place with clear visuals and built-in guidance to help you troubleshoot faster.

  • Visual dashboards to understand server usage at a glance
  • AI log summaries with impact, root causes, and next steps
  • Built-in traffic analytics
  • One control panel with no third-party patchwork

In-house experts available by chat, email, or callback, day or night. No outsourced teams. And if you need it, they'll build your starter website for you, free when you sign up for web hosting.
